purpose: Define rendezvous/signaling as explicit bootstrap metadata exchange for peer establishment, with official licensed relay and private relay options, and no ownership of application payload semantics.

topics.name: Rendezvous and Signaling Boundary
topics.purpose: Define rendezvous/signaling as explicit bootstrap metadata exchange for peer establishment, with official licensed relay and private relay options, and no ownership of application payload semantics.

semantics.official_rule: Official rendezvous/signaling service may be available to applicable license holders.
semantics.private_rule: Private rendezvous/signaling service is permitted where supported.
semantics.metadata_rule: Service carries only metadata required for peer discovery/session establishment.
semantics.payload_rule: Application payload is not owned by or semantically terminated at rendezvous.
semantics.cleanup_rule: Bootstrap records are removed or expired after establishment/cancellation according to explicit policy.
semantics.identity_rule: Rendezvous record/session identity is not the peer's semantic identity.
semantics.availability_rule: Relay availability is service state and not license or peer identity.

invariants.rule: Transport session, cryptographic material, signaling metadata and semantic identity remain separate; secure transport never implies application authorization.

hard_gates.condition: rendezvous stores application payload by default
rendezvous record becomes peer semantic identity
private relay forbidden without explicit rule
bootstrap metadata retained indefinitely without policy

references.purpose: Bootstrap metadata is bounded and cleaned.
Official rendezvous is a licensed shared service where applicable.

prose.summary: Define rendezvous/signaling as explicit bootstrap metadata exchange for peer establishment, with official licensed relay and private relay options, and no ownership of application payload semantics.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing WebRTC/PGP/rendezvous contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
